 BALTIMORE (WBFF) -- Updated 6 a.m. November 5 — After 18 dry days, rain finally returns to Maryland.
 Today's planner 
 Scattered showers are back Thursday with highs in the very mild mid 70s.
 Ravens forecast 
 A few showers and even an isolated storm is possible for the Ravens game tonight.
 Tomorrow's planner 
 Rain picks back up Friday morning into the afternoon with highs near 70.
 Weekend preview 
 Drier for the weekend and cooler with highs in the mid 60s Saturday and low 60s Sunday.
 Drier and cool next week with highs staying in the low 60s.
